scenes.tts: A Pa-sin-ee-an fibre typically fires at the press and at the release. In between, it is silent. Where does that brevity come from?
scenes.caption: A Pacinian fibre typically fires at the press and at the release. In between, it is silent. Where does that brevity come from?
scenes.visual: Title card: Peel the Onion. The burst, silence, burst trace under a press-hold-release bar. Question on screen: where does the brevity come from?
scenes.narration: A Pacinian fibre typically fires at the press and at the release. In between, it is silent. Where does that brevity come from?

scenes.tts: There are three suspects.
scenes.visual: A cut-away Pacinian corpuscle: the onion of layers outside, the nerve ending in the middle, the axon leaving.
scenes.narration: There are three suspects.

scenes.tts: First, the capsule. Its onion of layers could absorb a held press before it reaches the ending.
scenes.visual: The outer layers glow. Label: 1. capsule.
scenes.narration: First, the capsule. Its onion of layers could absorb a held press before it reaches the ending.

scenes.tts: Second, the ending's channels. They could open at the press, then close while the press is still held.
scenes.visual: Channels on the ending glow, open, then close. Label: 2. terminal channels.
scenes.narration: Second, the ending's channels. They could open at the press, then close while the press is still held.

scenes.tts: Third, the spike generator. It could stop firing even while the ending stays depolarized.
scenes.visual: The first stretch of axon glows. Label: 3. spike generator.
scenes.narration: Third, the spike generator. It could stop firing even while the ending stays depolarized.

scenes.tts: Two terms. The generator potential is the ending's graded depolarization, driven by the transduction current.
scenes.visual: Two traces stacked. Top: a smooth graded bump, labelled generator potential.
scenes.narration: Two terms. The generator potential is the ending's graded depolarization, driven by the transduction current.

scenes.tts: Impulses are the all-or-none action potentials it triggers further along the axon.
scenes.visual: Bottom: sharp spikes, labelled impulses, all-or-none.
scenes.narration: Impulses are the all-or-none action potentials it triggers further along the axon.

scenes.tts: The classic suspect was the capsule. In nineteen sixty-six, Low-en-stine and Skalak modelled it as fluid between elastic layers.
scenes.caption: The classic suspect was the capsule. In 1966, Loewenstein and Skalak modelled it as fluid between elastic layers.
scenes.visual: The layers drawn as springs with fluid between them. Label: Loewenstein and Skalak, 1966.
scenes.narration: The classic suspect was the capsule. In 1966, Loewenstein and Skalak modelled it as fluid between elastic layers.

scenes.tts: Follow one press. At the instant of the press, the fluid cannot move fast enough. The ending is squeezed.
scenes.visual: Press: the layers compress together and the core is squeezed; the ending flashes.
scenes.narration: Follow one press. At the instant of the press, the fluid cannot move fast enough. The ending is squeezed.

scenes.tts: During the hold, the fluid flows and the stretched layers take up the load. The core relaxes.
scenes.visual: Hold: fluid flows sideways between layers; the core returns to round; the ending goes dark while the probe stays down.
scenes.narration: During the hold, the fluid flows and the stretched layers take up the load. The core relaxes.

scenes.tts: At the release, the layers spring back and jolt the core a second time.
scenes.visual: Release: the layers snap outward; the core is jolted; the ending flashes again.
scenes.narration: At the release, the layers spring back and jolt the core a second time.

scenes.tts: So, in this model, the capsule strongly damps steady pressure and passes quick change. That is a high-pass filter.
scenes.visual: Label: classical model: steady pressure attenuated; rapid changes transmitted. High-pass filter.
scenes.narration: So, in this model, the capsule strongly damps steady pressure and passes quick change. That is a high-pass filter.

scenes.tts: A year earlier, in nineteen sixty-five, Low-en-stine and Mendel-son peeled most layers from cat corpuscles. Then they pressed and held.
scenes.caption: A year earlier, in 1965, Loewenstein and Mendelson peeled most layers from cat corpuscles. Then they pressed and held.
scenes.visual: Layers peel away from a corpuscle, leaving a bare ending. Label: Loewenstein and Mendelson, 1965, cat.
scenes.narration: A year earlier, in 1965, Loewenstein and Mendelson peeled most layers from cat corpuscles. Then they pressed and held.

scenes.tts: Predict. If the capsule did all the work, what should now last through the hold?
scenes.visual: Two empty traces wait: generator potential and impulses. Question on screen: what lasts through the hold?
scenes.narration: Predict. If the capsule did all the work, what should now last through the hold?

scenes.tts: Only half of it. The generator potential decayed much more slowly, mainly under intense compression.
scenes.visual: Top trace draws a slowly falling trace, not a flat plateau. Small label: mainly under intense compression.
scenes.narration: Only half of it. The generator potential decayed much more slowly, mainly under intense compression.

scenes.tts: But the impulses did not persist. The ending typically still fired a single spike.
scenes.visual: Bottom trace draws one spike at the start, then flat.
scenes.narration: But the impulses did not persist. The ending typically still fired a single spike.

scenes.tts: So brevity had two stages. One is the mechanics around the ending. The other is the spike-generating membrane.
scenes.visual: Two of the three labels light: capsule and spike generator.
scenes.narration: So brevity had two stages. One is the mechanics around the ending. The other is the spike-generating membrane.

scenes.tts: In twenty twenty-five, researchers recorded at the ending itself. They used bill skin from duck embryos.
scenes.caption: In 2025, researchers recorded at the ending itself. They used bill skin from duck embryos.
scenes.visual: A duck bill, then a zoom to a Pacinian-type corpuscle with a patch pipette on its central ending. Label: duck Herbst corpuscle, 2025, ex vivo.
scenes.narration: In 2025, researchers recorded at the ending itself. They used bill skin from duck embryos.

scenes.tts: They removed the onion, and kept the inner cells that hug the ending.
scenes.visual: The outer core lifts away; the inner core of lamellar cells stays around the ending. Labels: outer core removed, inner core kept.
scenes.narration: They removed the onion, and kept the inner cells that hug the ending.

scenes.tts: Predict. If the onion sets the brief response, what should happen to the ending's current?
scenes.visual: An empty current trace under a press-hold bar. Question on screen: slow and sustained, or still fast?
scenes.narration: Predict. If the onion sets the brief response, what should happen to the ending's current?

scenes.tts: It stayed fast. And the fibre's frequency tuning did not change significantly.
scenes.visual: The trace draws a fast inward current that inactivates quickly; a tuning curve beside it stays where it was.
scenes.narration: It stayed fast. And the fibre's frequency tuning did not change significantly.

scenes.tts: The current did grow larger. So the onion may still damp the force that arrives.
scenes.visual: The current trace redraws taller. Label: larger without the outer core.
scenes.narration: The current did grow larger. So the onion may still damp the force that arrives.

scenes.tts: How do the two results fit? In the duck, currents slowed only as stripped endings deteriorated.
scenes.visual: A timeline after dissection: the current trace slowly broadens as the ending fades.
scenes.narration: How do the two results fit? In the duck, currents slowed only as stripped endings deteriorated.

scenes.tts: So a damaged, dying ending can look like one that has lost its filter. That is one reading.
scenes.visual: Side by side: a fading ending and an ending without a filter, with similar slow traces. Label: one reading, not shown directly.
scenes.narration: So a damaged, dying ending can look like one that has lost its filter. That is one reading.

scenes.tts: Keep this. In this duck preparation, the ending stayed fast without the outer core. So fast adaptation does not need the onion there.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the three labels, with the capsule faded and the terminal channels and spike generator still lit. Line: outer core removed; inner core retained; rapid responses persist.
scenes.narration: Keep this. In this duck preparation, the ending stayed fast without the outer core. So fast adaptation does not need the onion there.
